result:
I’d make it much harder for people to turn one another into abstractions.

Not force agreement. Not make everyone endlessly kind. Just make another person’s inner life impossible to dismiss—their private fears, their history, the people who would miss them.

So much cruelty seems to require distance: a person becomes a category, a crowd becomes a statistic, an enemy stops being human. I’d take away that distance.
